senses.definition: An incident, action, or time period standing out by itself, but more or less connected with a complete series of events.
examples: It was a most embarrassing episode in my life.

quotes.text: The Attorney-General, however, had used this episode, which Martin in retrospect had felt to be a blot on the scutcheon, merely to emphasise the intelligence and resource of the prisoner.
quotes.reference: 1935, Francis Beeding [pseudonym; John Palmer], “10/6”, in The Norwich Victims, →OL:

quotes.text: Three of the great extinctions appear to have occurred during cold episodes and two during hot episodes.
quotes.reference: 2017, Anthony J. McMichael, Alistair Woodward, Cameron Muir, Climate Change and the Health of Nations, →ISBN, page 81:

senses.definition: An installment of a drama told in parts, as in a TV series.
examples: I can't wait till next week’s episode.

quotes.text: We all know how genius “Kamp Krusty,” “A Streetcar Named Marge,” “Homer The Heretic,” “Itchy & Scratchy: The Movie” and “Mr. Plow” are, but even the relatively unheralded episodes offer wall-to-wall laughs and some of the smartest, darkest, and weirdest gags ever Trojan-horsed into a network cartoon with a massive family audience.
